title: Expectation under the symmetrized seed law
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with a finite nonempty seed space, seed law, and deterministic trees that each compute $f$. Choose a coordinate permutation uniformly from the symmetry group of $f$, independently of the seed. For every real-valued function $g$ of the permutation and seed, its expectation under this joint law equals the average over permutations of its expectation over the seed law.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate permutation drawn uniformly from the symmetry group of $f$
